'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex O'Shea LS Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers|Theed-L-naboobossnassschambers.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Sonn (V) Speeders
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
